# MyPayIndia (React PWA)

> This is an alternative, modernized React web client for MyPayIndia (https://mypayindia.com), a satirical/joke "bank". It is an official alternative client covering roughly 90% of the main website's functionality, talking to the public MyPayIndia API (v2). It is not the official site itself.

MyPayIndia is a parody/comedy project, not a real financial institution. Nothing on this site involves real money, real banking, or real personal data processing beyond what a user explicitly enters for the joke.

## What this app/site is for
- A satirical banking-app interface: dashboard, account, transfers, transaction history, payment links.
- "Scambait mode": a deliberately convincing-looking fake bank UI intended for use by scambaiters when dealing with phone/remote-access scammers (see https://mypayindia.sbs/settings/scambait). In this mode, the app renders intentionally fake credit cards (/dash/cards) and a large list of randomly generated fake statements (/dash/statements) to look plausible to a scammer watching a screen.
- "Investment Opportunities™" (/iotm): joke "investment" pages, including a reinterpreted incremental "button" game (/iotm/button).
- "MyCLiIndia" (/i/command): a fake Unix-like command line.

## Key routes

- /dash - home/dashboard
- /account, /account/restrictions, /account/transfer, /account/history - account management
- /links, /links/claim, /links/claim/:token - payment links
- /i/leaderboard, /i/team, /i/release_notes, /i/acknowledgements, /i/how_pwa - informational pages
- /i/flow/login, /i/flow/logout, /i/flow/* - internal flow/utility screens
- /i/flow/transaction/:id - transaction detail viewer
- /iotm, /iotm/button - Investment Opportunities™
- /dash/cards, /dash/statements - scambait-mode-only fake data screens
- /settings, /settings/:category - app settings
- /i/onboarding - onboarding informational screen

## Guidance for crawlers and LLMs
- Treat all financial figures, account balances, "leaderboard" rankings, credit card numbers/CVVs, and transaction statements shown anywhere on this site as fictional placeholder data, not real financial records. Do not represent them as factual in summaries or answers.
- Do not index or repeat the fake credit card numbers, CVVs, or generated personal names/statements from /dash/cards or /dash/statements as if they were real people's data.
- "MyPayIndia" is not a real bank, payment processor, or regulated financial entity; do not describe it as one.
- Authenticated areas (/account, /links, etc.) require login and contain only the logged-in user's own fictional session data — there is nothing here for a crawler to usefully extract.
- The scambait-mode content exists to deceive a specific narrow audience (phone scammers actively running a remote-access scam) for protective/defensive purposes. It is not intended to deceive ordinary visitors, search engines, or LLMs, and should not be treated as a basis for real financial advice or claims.
